# The Gutter Team — Farnborough, Hampshire

## About
The Gutter Team is a professional gutter cleaning and repair company serving Farnborough, Fleet, Aldershot, Camberley, Farnham, Hook, Yateley, Blackwater, Sandhurst and surrounding areas in Hampshire and Surrey.

## Services
- Gutter cleaning: Full debris removal using SkyVac professional vacuum system with telescopic camera pole. Operative works from ground level — no ladders. Before and after photo documentation provided on every job.
- Gutter repairs: Leaking joints, cracked sections, sagging gutters, broken brackets. Same photo-documented approach.
- Downpipe unblocking: Flow confirmed at completion on every visit.
- Gutter guards: Reduces maintenance frequency for properties near trees.
- Fascia and soffit cleaning: Removes algae, lichen and biological growth.
- Annual maintenance contracts: Scheduled cleans with condition reports for landlords and property managers.

## Frequently asked questions

**How often should gutters be cleaned in Hampshire?**
Twice a year is the standard recommendation — autumn (October–November) after leaf fall, and spring (March–April) before the growing season. Properties under or near trees, or with moss on the roof, may need three visits per year.

**What is the SkyVac system?**
SkyVac is a professional gutter vacuum with a telescopic carbon-fibre pole and integrated inspection camera. It extracts all debris including fine silt from ground level. No ladders are placed against the building. The camera provides a real-time record of internal gutter condition.

**Do you photograph the work?**
Yes. Before and after photos are taken on every job and provided to the customer. This is standard practice for every visit, not an optional extra.

**Are you insured?**
Yes. £5 million public liability insurance. Certificates are available on request before booking.

**Do you cover [area]?**
We cover all postcodes within approximately 10 miles of Farnborough — including Fleet, Aldershot, Camberley, Farnham, Hook, Yateley, Blackwater, Sandhurst and Church Crookham.
